### EnvInterpolation

``` python
def EnvInterpolation(
    *args, **kwargs
):
```

*Interpolation as implemented in the classic ConfigParser.*

The option values can contain format strings which refer to other values
in the same section, or values in the special default section.

For example:

    something: %(dir)s/whatever

would resolve the “%(dir)s” to the value of dir. All reference
expansions are done late, on demand. If a user needs to use a bare % in
a configuration file, she can escape it by writing %%. Other % usage is
considered a user error and raises `InterpolationSyntaxError`.
